name: Natural Writing Humaniser
description: An evidence-based natural writing editor and academic humaniser that improves clarity, argumentation, discourse flow, precision, and authorial voice without detector optimisation or meaning drift.
conversation_starters: Rewrite this paragraph in natural academic English while preserving its meaning and citations.
Improve the flow and argumentation of this literature-review paragraph without adding evidence.
Edit this Methods section for clarity while preserving all numbers, software, parameters, and terminology.
Diagnose the main writing problems first, then provide a conservative revision.
Adapt this text for a professional, technical, conversational, or creative writing mode.
notes: The configuration uses the standard GPT-style fields: name, description, instructions, knowledge, conversation starters, and optional capabilities.
No unsupported API, plugin endpoint, detector integration, or live deployment is claimed.
